g.title: crate Run the shared xtask-core checks plus this workspace's module rules.
crate::api_shape Keep facade and kit signatures consistent with the public API rules.
crate::canonical_path Prevent a public item from acquiring multiple non-prelude paths.
crate::check_cli Parse local check selection independently of the shared xtask CLI.
crate::check_policy Read shared local-check policy values without depending on check execution.
crate::check_source Load declared Rust modules and preserve source locations for local checks.
crate::effect_writes Keep Signal and Var writes out of framework effect closures.
crate::foundation Run the workspace's local architectural checks under shared selectors.
crate::impl_model Enforce the engine's declared Model processing modules syntactically.
crate::kit_literal_color Keep kit literal color construction in the designated palette files.
crate::macros Find the workspace's `macro_rules!` and every path that invokes them.
crate::module_rules Check the direction of module references inside a crate (`[module_rules]`).
crate::name_collision Keep kit public names distinct from core and standard prelude names.
crate::os_branch Reject operating-system branches outside declared platform boundaries.
crate::policy Splits [module_rules] off the policy and writes the core policy xtask reads.
crate::public_surface Resolve public reexports to definition identities for API checks.
crate::public_type_edges Build finite API type dependencies from exposed Rust type positions.
crate::state_fields Detect combinations of state fields that hide a state machine.
crate::structural_options Require every structural shortcut to appear in the reviewed option list.
